title: chamomilla recutita var. bayeri
intro: Chamomilla recutita var. bayeri, commonly known as Alpine apple daisy, is a perennial herb belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and calming anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Chamomilla recutita var. bayeri include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative effects, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
